race.comment: LIGHT THE NIGHT (8) went back to the tail of the field from a wide alley then ran on late without threatening in open company over 1200m at Murray Bridge last start. Given a five-week let-up and drops in grade today. Stubby Holder reunites and this looks a lovely race for him. LAA DE SHA (4) came from well back to be beaten under two lengths when resuming over 1200m at Geelong last time out. Distance specialist who gets an economical run from the inside alley and will be hard to hold out when presented. ANOTHERHOUSE (7) is airborne this prep with two wins from as many runs, albeit in much weaker races. Drops a massive 7.5kgs and draws a perfect gate so he cannot be underestimated. GOLD SPIRIT (6) hasn't been too bad this prep in two shorter races. The winner of three from six at today's journey so he should come into his own now. DOBBINAIR (11) is chopping and changing his distances but this looks the right fit.
